title: Questions, information and answers — delta for the decision register

updates.answer_now: What counts as 'the market' is decided pragmatically: the fingerprinted nflverse/nfldata bookmaker line, labelled third-party on every row (F-06). Opening vs closing is now recorded in the price-snapshot store.
updates.still_missing: An official or licensed odds feed, and any source of opening numbers for 2026 games.
updates.unblocks: CLV measurement and demotion trigger D-2 stay blocked; everything else moves.

updates.answer_now: What counts as a settled result: the official score from nfl.com score pages, Game Center box scores or official Game Book PDFs, transcribed line by line and double-entry checked against the mirror (137/137 matched).
updates.still_missing: nothing for results; weeks 10-18 settle week by week as played.
updates.unblocks: backtests and ROI are computable at row level (data/lines/results_feed.json).

updates.answer_now: Demotion thresholds are pre-registered in data/lines/demotion_gate.json (G-13: skill reversal, CLV collapse, drawdown, source breach).
updates.still_missing: owner confirmation of the numeric thresholds (S-20 on the suggestion board).
updates.unblocks: strategies can go live without leaving the demotion path undefined.
